question: How many seats are still free in the CS3E1 Machine Learning elective?
answer:
There are currently 2 seats free in the CS3E1 Machine Learning elective [SQL].

| Course Code | Title | Free Seats |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| CS3E1 | Machine Learning | 2 |

This information is based on the University's course and enrollment records [Doc: Course Registration & Credit Policy 2026-27 §1 Scope].
sql: SELECT c.course_code, c.title, (c.capacity - COUNT(e.enrollment_id)) AS free_seats FROM courses AS c LEFT JOIN enrollments AS e ON c.course_id = e.course_id AND e.status = 'enrolled' WHERE c.course_code = 'CS3E1' GROUP BY c.course_code, c.title, c.capacity LIMIT 200
